description: This source file defines a React functional component called 'Rooms' that manages the display and CRUD operations for a list of hotel rooms, integrating UI components and calling external API services.

methods.name: fetchRooms
methods.description: Fetches the list of rooms from the API and updates the state.

methods.name: handleAdd
methods.description: Prepares the form for adding a new room and opens the modal.

methods.name: handleEdit
methods.description: Loads a room into the form for editing and opens the modal.

methods.name: handleDelete
methods.description: Deletes a specified room after user confirmation.

methods.name: handleSave
methods.description: Saves a new or updated room to the backend and refreshes the list.
